title: TaxBreak: Unmasking the Hidden Costs of LLM Inference Through Overhead Decomposition
summary_zh: Trace-driven 方法將 LLM 推理的主機端編排開銷分解為三層：框架執行 $\Delta FT$、CUDA library 前端 $\Delta CT$、與 kernel launch $\Delta KT$，並提出 HDBI（Host-Device Balance Index）作為主機/裝置邊界比率。在 H100/H200、dense 與 MoE 工作負載上驗證；發現 MoE 每個 output token 派送的 kernel 數為 dense 模型的 8–11×，更快的單執行緒 CPU 可降低 orchestration 開銷 10–29% 並縮短端對端延遲 11–14%。
summary_en: Trace-driven methodology that decomposes host-visible LLM inference orchestration overhead into three layers — framework execution $\Delta FT$, CUDA library front-end $\Delta CT$, and kernel launch $\Delta KT$ — and proposes HDBI (Host-Device Balance Index) as a host-vs-device boundedness ratio. Validated on NVIDIA H100/H200 across dense and MoE workloads; MoE models dispatch 8–11× more kernels per output token than dense models of comparable active parameter count, and a faster single-threaded CPU reduces orchestration overhead by 10–29% and end-to-end latency by 11–14%.
